svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Ceiling plate: a 1/2 in floor flange about 80 mm across. Drill or

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: open three 5.5 mm holes on a 60 mm circle if it has none.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Rod: a 1/2 in steel pipe nipple, 89 mm long, 21.3 mm across,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: threaded at both ends. Screw it hand tight into the flange.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Run one locknut up the rod so its underside is 85 mm below the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: flange's ceiling face: the head top sits on it, 85 mm down.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: flange on the ceiling directly over the apparatus centre

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: (plumb line), three M5 x 40 screws into ceiling plugs.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The rod goes up through the 21.7 mm hole in the head top; the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: second locknut goes on inside, through the open front.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: ports 175 mm below the ceiling, over the apparatus; the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: head does not turn when pushed by hand.
